# Pinned browser runtimes

- sql.js 1.13.0: https://github.com/sql-js/sql.js/releases/tag/v1.13.0 (MIT; see sqljs-LICENSE).
- Pyodide 0.27.7: https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/releases/tag/0.27.7 (see python/LICENSE).
- CPython standard library: Python Software Foundation license (see python/PSF-LICENSE).

Runtime files were downloaded from the versioned jsDelivr distributions. They are local assets, not execution services; student code is not uploaded to a CDN. manifest.json records sizes and SHA-256 checksums. No package manager or build step is needed to run the game. The Java teaching interpreter is original project code and uses no external Java service.
